scope: Broaden ACIS producer research beyond the existing local generator lead; classify output/readback lineage and native acceptance limits, and resolve whether the candidate's external ABC corpus can be assumed MIT-licensed.

method.kind: Primary project README, official dataset information, and linked terms review
method.evidenceBoundary: Project capabilities, test methodology, release maturity, and corpus licensing descriptions were read from public pages only. No source SHA was selected or executed, no peer output was generated, no ABC model was inspected, and no individual dataset-file license was audited. The research therefore adds optional comparator/producer leads and a conservative sample-admission rule, not support evidence.

evidence.topic: obj2cad producer, reader composition, and acceptance maturity
evidence.observed: The repository calls itself pre-release, states that ASCII/binary DXF is verified while DWG and curved surfaces remain beta until AutoCAD acceptance, and describes known ACIS primitive outputs. Its parity harness uses a separately implemented OBJ reader and reads DXF through ezdxf with audit or DWG through ACadRust. It says ACIS output is read by ezdxf and ACadRust and its DWG crate vendors a patched ACadRust writer. These are repository claims; none was run here.
doesNotEstablish: AutoCAD/ODA acceptance for the advertised outputs
an independent B-rep kernel result from ezdxf carrier inspection
a DWG writer independent of ACadRust lineage
that a generated ACIS surface is a closed 3DSOLID body
behavior of a pinned source revision or binary
evidence.planUse: Keep obj2cad optional and composed-checkpoint-only as a potential locally authored DXF/ACIS producer. Before use pin the exact source and build, record the DXF version/carrier/output hash and diagnostics, independently define analytic expectations, and label geometry results by surface/open-shell/closed-solid scope. Do not use its own parity harness as native acceptance.

evidence.topic: ACadRust fork with SAT/SAB writer claims
evidence.observed: The repository identifies itself as an MPL-2.0 ACadRust fork for a viewer. Its README advertises SAT text generation for R2000-R2007, SAB output for R2013+, several analytic primitives, and 208/208 DWG round-trip integrity across 26 entity types and eight versions. This is a self-reported capability/round-trip claim, and the fork preserves the upstream ACadRust parser lineage.
doesNotEstablish: an independent DWG reader or writer lineage
the exact commit/build underlying each advertised result
evidence.planUse: Admit only as an optional source-inspection or controlled ACIS/DXF producer lead after pinning the commit and dependency graph. Require independent syntax inspection and a hand-authored analytic manifest; never aggregate its round-trip count into support totals or count it as a second ACadRust-lineage DWG vote.

evidence.topic: ABC dataset provenance and license qualification
evidence.observed: The obj2cad README calls its ABC-dataset test data MIT-licensed. The official ABC dataset page says CAD-model copyright is owned by the creators and points to Onshape Terms of Use. The current terms describe conditional reuse rights for certain Public Documents and preserve greater reserved rights in specified cases; the official dataset page does not make a blanket MIT grant for every model. No specific model or source document was reviewed.
doesNotEstablish: the license status of any individual ABC model
that every model was created by a Free Plan User or lacks a reserved LICENSE tab
permission to copy any corpus file into this repository
evidence.planUse: Do not download, import, or commit ABC models based only on the downstream project's README. Audit provenance and the applicable license per item before optional use. Prefer locally generated analytic controls; if permitted external data is ever used, keep it outside the repository in a disposable cache and record its exact provenance.

nextActions: Continue local implementation and per-slice fast validation without waiting for optional producer projects.
At the composed 3D producer gate, use locally authored asymmetric analytic geometry and independently calculate expectations.
Keep inline SAT, modern DXF ACDSDATA/SAB, and DWG AcDs owner association as distinct versioned routes.
If a peer producer is selected, pin exact source/build, inspect whether outputs are surfaces or closed solids, and keep DWG paths descended from ACadRust in one lineage.
Do not use ABC corpus assets until per-item provenance and applicable rights are verified; no fixture files are authorized by this review.
Leave J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
